ns2:course.label: Freshmen Scholars Seminar
ns2:course.description: Designed for James Scholars for Applied Health Sciences who are in their first year of college to introduce them to research. Students will learn strategies to apply classroom material to community and society. Includes visits from faculty and staff from across campus and within the College who will expose students to an array of contexts and approaches for research. This course is a James Scholar course for freshmen only.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Applied Health Sciences. Restricted to students with Freshman class standing.
ns2:course.sectionCappArea: Restricted to James Scholars Program students.
